test_SourceProfiles_total_sources: test the SourceProfiles.total_sources method sums ion and electron temperature profiles correctly with and without jax.jit
test_SourceProfiles_merge: test the SourceProfiles.merge method combines implicit and explicit source profiles by summing their values
test_SourceProfiles_merge_preserves_fast: test that SourceProfiles.merge preserves fast ion data when it appears in explicit source profiles
test that SourceProfiles.merge preserves fast ion data when it appears in implicit source profiles
test_SourceProfiles_jit_invariance: test that summed temperature profiles produce identical results when called directly or through jax.jit
